name: Spout4GD
description: Captures the game screen using Spout2

stream-options.name: Stream Options
stream-options.description: Set output settings like FPS and (soon) fixed output resolution

output-resolution.name: Output Resolution
output-resolution.description: Enable and set a custom output resolution. If disabled, window size will be used.

show-cursor.name: Capture cursor
show-cursor.description: Renders the system cursor to the output.

cursor-filter.name: Cursor filter
cursor-filter.description: Sets the filter to use when rendering the cursor. Nearest is useful for pixel art.
